text:
Maya: Heads-up — planning a canary for release v3-infer-optimizer next Wed 2026-03-25 09:00 PT. Aim: gradual ramp 5% -> 25% -> 60%. Need deploy owner, smoke lead, rollback tag, and cohort mapping. Comments?

Chris: I can be deploy owner. Prefer start at 09:15 PT so infra stacks stable.

Sam: I'll own smoke. I'll run the usual smoke checklist and post a quick summary. :+1: 

Maya: Thanks. Smoke checklist: gen smoke (5 warm requests / host), p95 latency < 250ms, errors < 0.5%, cache hit > 60%, and no auth regressions. Post logs to #eng-sre if anything odd.

Nina: Suggest cohorts: 5% internal (eng + dogfood), 20% beta customers, then 35% public in us-west + eu-west. Keep apac blocked until 24h clean. :eyes: 

Chris: Sounds good. Timeline suggestion: 5% for 30m, 25% for 60m, 60% for 120m. We'll hold between steps for smoke green.

Sam: OK. I'll run smoke at +10m after ramp to ensure prefix cache warmed. I'll use the smoke script:

```bash
./smoke/run_smoke.sh --model v3-infer-optimizer --qps 10 --duration 5m
```

Chris: Rollback plan: tag unroll point is release v3-prev. If any step fails, we revert to v3-prev and rotate routing back in 5 mins. Rollback owner: Chris. Notify ops and product.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for 2026-03-25T09:15:00Z. cohort mapping set to [internal->5, beta->20, public->35]. :rocket: 

Maya: Quick CR ping — @Chris can you confirm the DB migration is not required? I think it's noop.

Chris: Confirmed — no schema changes. Just config toggles.

Sam: I'll post pass/fail summary after each ramp step. If green after 6h we can consider wider rollout. :thumbsup: 

Maya: Perfect. I'll update the release doc and add owners. TL;DR: deploy=Chris, smoke=Sam, rollback=Chris, cohorts=internal/beta/public, ramp 5/25/60, hold windows 30/60/120m. Any last blockers?

Nina: None from infra. :+1: 

Chris: All set. I'll create the actual deploy window in calendar and ping again on Tue for final go/no-go.
